story_log.title: Red Sox complete four-game sweep of Yankees with Jarren Duran walk-off, last-place AL team mops first-place NY
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 5]: Boston completed four-game sweep of Yankees with Jarren Duran walk-off single in 10th inning Sunday night (5-4 final). Red Sox entered series with worst record in AL, Yankees had best. Sonny Gray dominated NY (2,000th career K milestone). Jazz Chisholm Jr. ejected for check-swing argument (ump cam angle viral). Boston now just 4.5 GB of third wild card despite dismal overall record. Yankees fell into second place in AL East behind Rays after sweep.

story_log.title: Scottie Scheffler and Viktor Hovland tied after darkness halts Travelers Championship playoff, resume Monday morning
story_log.development: NEW: Final round Sunday stopped by darkness with Scheffler and Hovland tied in playoff. Will resume Monday morning to decide last PGA Tour signature event of season. Free golf tomorrow per BarstoolBigCat.

story_log.title: Fire and Mystics tie WNBA record with quadruple-overtime thriller, Washington wins 124-123 in second 4OT game in league history
story_log.development: NEW: Portland and Washington played to quadruple overtime (124-123 Mystics win), only second 4OT game in WNBA history. Mystics only team ever to play in multiple 4OT games (2-0). Carla Leite 32 PTS/6 REB/9 AST (career-highs), Sonia Citron 32 PTS/6 REB (career-high) in 53 minutes. Game lasted over three hours, players exhausted.

story_log.title: Suns acquire Miles Bridges in trade with Hornets, Charlotte picks up 2033 first-rounder in salary dump
story_log.development: NEW: Phoenix acquired Miles Bridges, 2029 first-round pick, 2027 second-round pick from Charlotte for Grayson Allen, Royce O'Neale, 2033 first-round pick per Shams. Suns get 28-year-old starting PF they've targeted for years, save $20M in tax. Hornets pick up valuable unprotected 2033 pick (further out than usual), add two playoff-tested role players. Charlotte traded LaMelo Ball to Timberwolves Saturday, now trading Bridges—dismantling young core after best season in years.

story_log.title: Warriors reportedly interested in signing LeBron James and trading for Anthony Davis to pair with Stephen Curry
story_log.development: NEW: Golden State seeking to create one more title run for Steph, reportedly interested in signing LeBron and trading for AD per CBS Sports. PFTCommenter: 'AD for Steph curry who says no.' Curry entering age-38 season, Warriors looking to maximize championship window.

story_log.title: Canada advances to World Cup knockout round for first time in history after 1-0 stoppage-time winner vs South Africa
story_log.development: NEW: Canada scored in 92nd minute (stoppage time) to beat South Africa 1-0 and reach Round of 16 for first time in program history. Jonathan David scored late winner. Crowd went wild, entire stadium chanting. BarstoolBigCat: 'CANADA!!!' South Africa eliminated. RedditCFB: 'It would be crazy if Canada won the World Cup while on a 33-year Stanley Cup drought.' Historic moment for Canadian soccer.

story_log.title: NBA Draft Day 2: Clippers rebuff Kawhi Leonard trade inquiries, Timberwolves pair LaMelo Ball with Anthony Edwards in Kendrick Perkins' 'best backcourt in NBA'
story_log.development: NEW: Clippers have received multiple trade calls for Kawhi Leonard, rebuffing all offers per ClutchPoints/TomerAzarly/BrettSiegelNBA. LA willing to hear offers but not engaging themselves, plan to keep Kawhi and pursue extension. Kendrick Perkins on Timberwolves-LaMelo trade (from 6/26): 'Now, all of a sudden, you bring back LaMelo [Ball], with Anthony Edwards. That is the best backcourt in the NBA. I repeat, that is the best f*cking backcourt in the NBA.' ClutchPoints on Charlotte's rebuild: Hornets turned page, moved LaMelo and Bridges, future now rests on Brandon Miller and Kon Knueppel.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson becomes first WNBA player ever with 30 PTS, 15 REB, 4 STL, 3 BLK in single game
story_log.development: NEW: Wilson vs Chicago: 30 PTS, 15 REB, 4 STL, 3 BLK. First player in WNBA history to record those numbers in a game per StatMuse. Aces beat Sky 107-99.

story_log.title: Cubs walk off Brewers in 10th inning after Kyle Kuhnel walks in go-ahead run
story_log.development: NEW: Kuhnel walked in go-ahead run in 10th inning, Cubs beat Brewers 4-3 per TalkinBaseball. Seiya Suzuki homered earlier in game. Chicago wins tight series in Milwaukee.

story_log.title: Rays sweep Diamondbacks behind Isaac Paredes' 10th-inning RBI, win five straight
story_log.development: NEW: Paredes drove in go-ahead run in 10th, Tampa swept Arizona and extended win streak to five games per TalkinBaseball. Junior Caminero homered in fourth straight game. Rays rolling.

story_log.title: Guardians score five runs in eighth inning to erase Mariners lead, complete comeback win
story_log.development: NEW: Cleveland trailed Seattle, then scored 5 in eighth to take lead and win 6-5 per TalkinBaseball. Chase DeLauter drove in two to tie game. Guardians rally late.

story_log.title: Manny Machado ties game with 15th homer of year, Dodgers beat Padres 4-2
story_log.development: NEW: Machado hit high drive to tie game with 15th HR per TalkinBaseball. LA still won 4-2 per ground truth. Padres fall short despite Machado blast.

story_log.title: Rangers complete four-game sweep of Blue Jays after Jarred Kelenic scores from second on wild pitch in ninth
story_log.development: NEW: Kelenic scored from second on wild pitch to give Texas lead in 9th, Rangers swept Toronto 3-2 per TalkinBaseball. Nathan Lukes tied game in 8th with 2-run shot. Blue Jays now 1-6 in last seven games per StatMuse, 6 games under .500. Texas in sole possession of first place in AL West.

story_log.title: Pirates' Ryan O'Hearn hits two homers vs Reds, third in hits and RBI this season for Pittsburgh
story_log.development: NEW: O'Hearn vs Cincinnati: 3 H, 2 HR, 4 RBI. Third in hits and RBI this season for Pirates per StatMuse. Pittsburgh won 9-4.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber becomes first player to hit 30 home runs in 2026 after clubbing his 30th vs Brewers
story_log.development: NEW: Schwarber hit 30th homer of season vs Milwaukee, first player to reach 30 in 2026 per ClutchPoints. Philadelphia slugger continues torrid pace.

story_log.title: Golden State Valkyries upset New York Liberty 76-67, expansion team stuns defending champions
story_log.development: NEW: Valkyries (expansion franchise) beat Liberty 76-67 per ground truth. New York falls to Golden State in upset loss.

story_log.title: Druski hosts BET Awards, remakes 'MICHAEL' prequel and Mega Church sketch in viral performances
story_log.development: NEW: Druski hosted BET Awards, performed prequel to 'MICHAEL' called 'JOE' and remade Mega Church skit per HaterReport viral videos. 'Nah man REAL TEARS' and 'Nah man Druski is OUT OF CONTROL lmaoo. Who let bro host the BET Awards' reactions. Entertainment story, NOT sports—cut entirely per TWEET FILTER RULE 1.

story_log.title: Judge David Doty passes away, NFL releases statement honoring longtime jurist who presided over NFL litigation for decades
story_log.development: NEW: Judge Doty passed away per Pelissero. NFL statement: 'Judge Doty devoted his life to public service and the law, presiding over NFL-related litigation for many years during his distinguished career. We express our sincere condolences to his family, friends and colleagues.' No age or cause of death given.

story_log.title: World Cup Group Stage Finale: Chaos, upsets, and heartbreak on final day as Round of 32 field set
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 14]: Algeria-Austria match produced insane ending: Algeria scored go-ahead goal in 93rd minute (Mahrez), Austria equalized in 96th minute (Kalajdzic) to finish 3-3. Result eliminated Iran, who watched on TV as Algeria's goal briefly sent them through before Austria crushed dreams seconds later. Messi came off bench and scored free-kick banger (#6 of tournament, first to score in 7 consecutive WC matches). Argentina beat Jordan 3-1. Congo DR beat Uzbekistan 3-1 to advance. England beat Panama 2-0. Croatia beat Ghana 2-1 (Modric guiding next generation). Portugal-Colombia ended 0-0 (Ronaldo bicycle kick attempt went viral, Colombia had goal disallowed by VAR for toe offside). Round of 32 bracket now set.

story_log.title: Messi becomes first player to score in 7 consecutive World Cup matches, leads Golden Boot race at age 39
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 6]: Messi subbed on from bench vs Jordan, scored free-kick banger (#6 of tournament), now first player in WC history to score in 7 consecutive matches. Leads Golden Boot race (6 goals) alongside Mbappé (6). Argentinian fans gave massive ovation when he entered match. Lo Celso's earlier free kick also went viral (insane bend from this angle).

story_log.title: Dodgers demolish Padres 15-3 behind three-homer inning, Kyle Tucker and Dalton Rushing go back-to-back
story_log.development: NEW: Los Angeles crushed San Diego 15-3. Tucker hit 2-run HR, Rushing went back-to-back with Tucker (Dodgers' third homer of same inning). Mookie Betts homered in third straight game. Steve Kerr attended Padres game (via THEREAL_DV). Freddie Freeman made jump throw double play at first base. LA offense explodes for 15 runs.

story_log.title: Hunter Goodman hits three homers vs Twins, first Rockies player with 3-HR game since Nolan Arenado in 2017
story_log.development: NEW: Goodman hit three home runs (5 RBI) in Colorado's 8-5 win over Minnesota. Four homers in his last five at-bats. First Rockie with 3 HR and 5 RBI in a game since Arenado in 2017 per StatMuse. Breakout performance for Goodman.

story_log.title: Mets snap 7-game losing streak after killing Mr. Met, beat Phillies 6-2 behind Pete Crow-Armstrong acquisition
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 8]: Mets ended 7-game losing streak, beat Phillies 6-2. TalkinBaseball: 'So Mr. Met celebrates during the losing streak then they kill him and the Mets win...' David Peterson (acquired from Cubs) went 5.2 IP in debut, longest outing since August 24 of last season (21 straight Mets starts without going that deep). Mets now 7-game losing streak, longest active in MLB alongside Blue Jays' 5-game streak. Two of four largest payrolls in baseball per StatMuse.

story_log.title: Rafael Devers hits two homers including three-run blast off foul pole as Red Sox beat Yankees 4-1
story_log.development: NEW: Devers homered twice vs Yankees: solo shot earlier in game, then golf-swung three-run blast off foul pole in late innings. Boston beat New York 4-1. Red Sox win series in Bronx.

story_log.title: Gerrit Cole posts worst month since 2017, Yankees lose to Red Sox as ace struggles continue
story_log.development: NEW: Cole this month: 1-3 REC, 25.0 IP, 6.12 ERA. Highest ERA in a month with 25+ IP since June 2017 per StatMuse. Yankees lost to Red Sox 4-1, Cole's struggles mounting.

story_log.title: Flau'jae Johnson posts 24-11 on 9-12 shooting, first rookie since Nneka Ogwumike with those numbers on 75%+ FG
story_log.development: NEW: Flau'jae vs Atlanta: 24 PTS, 11 REB, 2 STL on 9-12 FG. First rookie since Ogwumike to post those numbers on 75%+ FG in single game per StatMuse. Seattle beat Atlanta 105-90. Flau'jae's breakout night. Angel Reese completely ignored her in first WNBA game against former LSU teammate per HaterReport.

story_log.title: Kelsey Mitchell drops 26 on 9-13 shooting as Fever improve to 2-0 without Caitlin Clark this season
story_log.development: NEW: Mitchell vs LA: 26 PTS on 9-13 FG, +30. Indiana beat Sparks 111-87. Fever are 2-0 without Clark this season per StatMuse. Mitchell carrying load in Clark's absence.

story_log.title: Otto Lopez leads MLB with 109 hits and .336 average, already has 134 hits from all of last season
story_log.development: NEW: Lopez this season: 109 H (1st in MLB), 21 2B (T-3rd in MLB), .336 AVG (1st in MLB). He had 134 hits all of last season per StatMuse. Blue Jays' breakout hitter.

story_log.title: Michael Wacha dominates White Sox (7.1 IP, 1 R, 7 SO) but Royals lose anyway
story_log.development: NEW: Wacha vs Chicago: 7.1 IP, 1 R, 7 SO. Kansas City lost the game per StatMuse. Royals can't support ace.

story_log.title: Eugenio Suarez hits 3-run homer with Reds down to final strike to beat Pirates 9-7
story_log.development: NEW: Reds trailed Pirates entering 9th. Suarez hit 3-run homer with Cincinnati down to their final strike to take lead. Reds won 9-7 per TalkinBaseball. Incredible comeback.

story_log.title: Seiya Suzuki takes Kyle Harrison deep to give Cubs lead over Brewers
story_log.development: NEW: Suzuki hit homer off Giants' Harrison to give Chicago lead. Cubs beat Brewers 8-2 per ground truth. Suzuki delivering.

story_log.title: Logan Webb shuts down Braves as Giants cruise 5-0
story_log.development: NEW: Webb dominated Atlanta, Giants won 5-0 per TalkinBaseball and ground truth. San Francisco pitching stifles Braves.

story_log.title: Royals 3B Nick Loftin hit in manhood by pitch, leaves game
story_log.development: NEW: Loftin took pitch to groin area, left Royals game vs White Sox per Jomboy. Kansas City lost 2-1. Painful exit.

story_log.title: Jackson Chourio gets thrown out after thinking Dansby Swanson didn't catch ball—he did
story_log.development: NEW: Chourio thought ball went into center field because Swanson caught it and acted as if he didn't. Chourio got thrown out easily per Jomboy. Cubs beat Brewers 8-2. Heads-up play by Swanson.

story_log.title: Chandler Simpson somehow avoids tag from Nolan Arenado after review confirms safe call
story_log.development: NEW: Simpson avoided Arenado tag on play at third base. Review upheld safe call per Jomboy. Incredible tag avoidance.

story_log.title: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. tries to put home run jacket on Alejandro Kirk, gets rejected
story_log.development: NEW: Vlad tried to put HR jacket on Kirk after Kirk's homer. Kirk rejected the jacket per Jomboy. Blue Jays humor amid 5-game losing streak.

story_log.title: Rays announcer brings up Max Kepler's 80-game steroid suspension after he just misses homer: '80 games ago that's probably a homer'
story_log.development: NEW: Kepler just missed home run vs Rays. Tampa Bay announcer: '80 games ago that's probably a homer' (referencing Kepler's 80-game PED suspension) per Jomboy/TalkinBaseball. Savage commentary.

story_log.title: Jarren Duran not interested in talking about something postgame, gives terse responses
story_log.development: NEW: Duran gave short answers to reporters after Red Sox game. TalkinBaseball: 'Safe to say Jarren Duran was not interested in talking about this.' Boston won.

story_log.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's attempted bicycle kick vs Colombia goes hilariously wrong
story_log.development: NEW: Ronaldo tried bicycle kick vs Colombia, completely whiffed per HaterReport viral video. Portugal drew 0-0. Ronaldo's WC struggles continue (went 90 minutes with 0 goals, 0 shots on target, 0 assists—now 1,000 minutes since last non-penalty WC/Euro goal).

story_log.title: Ronaldo's free kick attempt vs Colombia becomes instant meme
story_log.development: NEW: Ronaldo took free kick vs Colombia, sent it into stands per HaterReport. Internet put Ronaldo's free kick and Messi's free kick side-by-side. Ronaldo when he not playing Uzbekistan per HaterReport. Portugal highlights vs Colombia: nothing. Ronaldo's WC woes.

story_log.title: Colombia's late winner vs Portugal called back for toe offside after VAR review
story_log.development: NEW: Colombia scored late goal that would have beaten Portugal. VAR ruled it offside by a toe. HaterReport: 'Imagine having a game winner taken off the board because of your big toe.' Portugal-Colombia ended 0-0. VAR controversy.

story_log.title: Jordan World Cup fan makes sign calling out Michael Jordan: 'SORRY MICHAEL WE WERE JORDAN FIRST'
story_log.development: NEW: Jordan fan held sign at Argentina match: 'SORRY MICHAEL WE WERE JORDAN FIRST' per HaterReport. Argentina beat Jordan 3-1. Wholesome World Cup moment.

story_log.title: Jaron 'Boots' Ennis stops Xander Zayas via TKO to become unified 154-pound champion
story_log.development: NEW: Ennis defeated Zayas via TKO (corner stoppage) in Brooklyn Saturday night to unify 154-pound titles. Zayas dropped twice before corner stepped in. CBS Sports covered. Boots now unified king.

story_log.title: Nuggets should be concerned if Nikola Jokić doesn't sign extension this offseason—he's reportedly considering bypassing it
story_log.development: NEW: Jokić eligible for 4-year extension but reportedly considering bypassing move this summer per CBS Sports. Nuggets should be concerned if reigning MVP doesn't lock in long-term. Denver future in question.

story_log.title: Braves sign veteran 1B Carlos Santana to minor-league deal after Diamondbacks release
story_log.development: NEW: Atlanta signed Santana (40) to minor-league contract per Passan. Will head to Triple-A, provides insurance for Braves. Released by Arizona earlier this week. Veteran depth move.

story_log.title: Magic waive Jonathan Isaac after seven injury-plagued seasons
story_log.development: NEW: Orlando announced they waived Isaac per Chris Haynes. Seven-season Magic career marred by injuries. Isaac's tenure ends.

story_log.title: Celtics re-sign Ron Harper Jr. to 3-year, $9M deal after declining team option
story_log.development: NEW: Harper intends to sign new 3yr/$9M to return to Boston per Shams. Celtics declined $2.6M team option, clearing way for longer deal. Harper went from training camp deal to two-way to conversion to multi-year guarantee. Celtics locking up depth.

story_log.title: Maple Leafs select Gavin McKenna No. 1 in NHL Draft, Sharks take Ivar Stenberg No. 2
story_log.development: NEW: McKenna selected No. 1 overall by Toronto (18-year-old Penn State winger, 15 G/51 PTS in 35 GP). Sharks took Ivar Stenberg No. 2. Wyatt Cullen (son of 3x Cup champion Matt Cullen) went 10th to Predators. Bettman booed by Buffalo crowd. McKenna met Justin Bieber after being drafted. Draft took place Friday evening.

story_log.title: Jacob Misiorowski throws 105.5 mph pitch, breaks own record for fastest by starting pitcher in pitch-tracking era
story_log.development: NEW: Misiorowski threw 105.5 mph fastball in 1st inning Friday vs Cubs (6-2 Brewers win), breaking his own record for fastest pitch by starting pitcher since pitch tracking began in 2008. Now 9-3 REC, 1.45 ERA (1st in MLB), 146 SO (1st in MLB, no other pitcher has more than 127).

story_log.title: World Cup Friday: Cape Verde advances in first-ever WC, Uruguay eliminated on keeper blunder, Dembélé hat trick for France
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 13]: Cape Verde advanced to Round of 32 in first-ever World Cup with 0-0 draw vs Saudi Arabia (smallest nation by population to ever make knockouts). Uruguay eliminated after goalkeeper Muslera blunder gifted Spain 1-0 win (Muslera pulled at halftime). France beat Norway 4-1 behind Ousmane Dembélé's first-half hat trick (fastest WC hat trick in 72 years). Belgium beat New Zealand 5-1 to win Group G. Egypt and Iran drew 1-1. Cape Verde will face Argentina in Round of 32 in Miami.

story_log.title: White Sox drop 22 runs on Royals, most since 1970, behind grand slam and 10-run inning
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago crushed Kansas City 22-1 Friday night. Tristan Peters hit grand slam and finished with 6 RBI. Miguel Vargas had 3-run HR and RBI double in 10-run third inning. 22 runs are most by White Sox since 1970 (June 20, 1970). TalkinBaseball, ClutchPoints covered blowout.

story_log.title: Thunder re-sign Isaiah Hartenstein to 3-year, $75M extension, locking up championship anchor
story_log.development: NEW: Hartenstein intends to sign new 3-year contract ($75M in new money, $134M total over 5 years guaranteed) to stay with Oklahoma City through 2028-29 per Shams. Deal includes max 15% trade kicker and unique mutual option allowing both sides to rework in 2028. Key defensive anchor after 2024 signing led to 2025 championship. OKC also traded Isaiah Joe to Pistons for two 2nd-rounders Friday (salary flexibility move).

story_log.title: Kamilla Cardoso sets WNBA record with 13-13 FG performance, 30 points in Sky blowout
story_log.development: NEW: Cardoso went 13-13 FG (30 PTS, 8 REB) in Chicago's 124-94 win over Portland Friday night at Wintrust Arena. Most made field goals without a miss in WNBA history. Previous record unclear. Sky dominate Fire.

story_log.title: Angels fire GM Perry Minasian after never logging winning season, bring in John Mozeliak as consultant
story_log.development: NEW: Los Angeles fired GM Perry Minasian Friday, never had a winning season in his tenure. Angels on pace for another last-place finish in AL West. Brought in longtime exec John Mozeliak (former Cardinals GM) as consultant to baseball ops department. TalkinBaseball, CBS Sports covered move.

story_log.title: Mets fire manager Carlos Mendoza after 34-47 start, continuing organizational nightmare
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Mets lost first game after firing Mendoza, fell to Phillies 2-1 Friday night. Shortstop Francisco Lindor and president David Stearns both assumed responsibility for dismal start postgame. 'We failed him,' Lindor said. Mets now 34-47 (13 under .500), 6-game losing streak.

story_log.title: Hurricanes lose leading scorer Seth Jarvis for 4-6 months after shoulder surgery announcement
story_log.development: NEW: Carolina GM Eric Tulsky announced Friday night that leading goal scorer Seth Jarvis (typically plays wing of No. 1 center Sebastian Aho) will undergo shoulder surgery and likely miss 4-6 months, including start of Stanley Cup defense. Major blow to reigning champions.

story_log.title: Zack Wheeler dominates Mets again as Phillies win 2-1, extends scoreless streak
story_log.development: NEW: Wheeler threw 7.0 IP, 4 H, 1 ER, 1 BB, 5 SO vs Mets in Philly's 2-1 win Friday. Has 1.47 ERA in last 5 starts vs NYM. Philadelphia beats Mets for second straight night.

story_log.title: Red Sox crush Yankees 6-1 behind Willson Contreras homer, benches clear after inside pitch
story_log.development: NEW: Boston beat New York 6-1 Friday night. Willson Contreras hit homer onto Lansdowne Street. Benches cleared after Yankees pitcher Will Warren pitched inside and Contreras took exception. Payton Tolle dominated NY (TalkinBaseball: 'turned in a dominant outing'). Derek Hill robbed Juan Soto with insane catch. Red Sox rolling.

story_log.title: Trevor Rogers shuts down Astros as Tigers cruise 8-0, allowed 1 ER in last 13.1 IP
story_log.development: NEW: Rogers threw 6.1 IP, 5 H, 1 ER, 0 BB, 7 SO vs Washington (ground truth says Baltimore beat Nationals 3-1, but tweets reference Tigers-Astros 8-0). Rogers has allowed 1 ER in 13.1 IP over last two starts. Detroit rolling.

story_log.title: Royce Lewis walks off Rockies after Colorado rallied from 7-0 deficit to take lead
story_log.development: NEW: Twins led Rockies 7-0, then Colorado stormed back to take lead. Royce Lewis walked off Minnesota 9-8 in extras. TalkinBaseball highlighted rally and walk-off. Wild comeback attempt falls short for Colorado.

story_log.title: Reds pitcher Tejay Antone salutes Pittsburgh crowd after hitting Konnor Griffin with pitch
story_log.development: NEW: Antone hit Pirates' Konnor Griffin with pitch, then saluted Pittsburgh crowd as he exited game Friday. Jomboy breakdown. Cincinnati beat Pittsburgh 6-4. Griffin had homered in first game back off IL earlier in night.

story_log.title: Orioles shut out Nationals 3-1 behind strong pitching
story_log.development: NEW: Baltimore beat Washington 1-3 (ground truth shows Orioles 3, Nationals 1). Pitching dominated. O's win on road.

story_log.title: Lionel Messi will start on bench for Argentina's final group game vs Jordan, resting with first place clinched
story_log.development: NEW: Messi will start Argentina's final group stage match against Jordan Saturday from substitutes' bench, coach Lionel Scaloni announced Friday. Messi has 5 goals already in tournament. Argentina already clinched first place in Group J. CBS Sports, ESPN covered.

story_log.title: Knicks re-sign Jose Alvarado to 3-year, $14M+ deal, retain NY native who played key role on title team
story_log.development: NEW: Alvarado declined $4.5M player option, intends to sign new 3-year, $14M+ deal to return to New York per Shams and Haynes. Knicks made it a priority to retain NY native who played key role on historic championship team. Locked up Friday.

story_log.title: Linda Cohn retires from ESPN after 34 years, Lil Wayne and John Buccigross give her flowers
story_log.development: NEW: Cohn is retiring after 34 amazing years at ESPN. Lil Wayne gave her flowers on air before she left. John Buccigross: 'Energy and fun. That is Linda Cohn.' Cohn on key to 34 years of excellence: 'Even though I was on SportsCenter for 34 years, I may believe someone is watching me for the very first time and I have to prove, to them, that I belong.' SportsCenter honored her Friday.

story_log.title: USMNT loses final group-stage game 3-2 to Turkey after late stoppage-time goal but advances to knockout round as Group D winners
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 12]: USA lost final group game 3-2 to Turkey after Kaan Ayhan scored winner in 95th minute. Meaningless game (both teams' fates already decided): USA already won Group D, Turkey already eliminated. Pochettino made nine changes to lineup, rested starters. Ricardo Pepi started, Christian Pulisic subbed on in second half. Sebastian Berhalter (Gregg's son) scored screamer to level 2-2. Turkey scored late goal to win despite being out of tournament. USA still finishes first in Group D, advances to Round of 32 vs Bosnia on July 1. Pulisic returned from calf issue (missed last week's win), played ~45 min.

story_log.title: World Cup Wednesday: Germany upset 2-1 by Ecuador, Netherlands beat Tunisia 3-1, Japan-Sweden draw 1-1, knockout bracket set
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 12]: Final group-stage games Wednesday (June 25). Germany (Group E winners entering match) lost 2-1 to Ecuador in stunning upset. Netherlands beat Tunisia 3-1. Japan and Sweden drew 1-1. Group stage now complete, Round of 32 matchups locked in. USA will face Bosnia on July 1 per ClutchPoints.

story_log.title: Toronto Tempo's Marina Mabrey ties WNBA single-game scoring record with 53 points, also ties three-point record with 9 threes
story_log.development: NEW: Mabrey vs LA Sparks: 53 PTS (ties WNBA all-time single-game record), 17-28 FG, 9-18 3PT (ties WNBA single-game three-point record), 10-12 FT. Joins A'ja Wilson, Liz Cambage, Riquna Williams as only four players ever to score 50+ in a game. All four hold record at 53. Tempo won 125-97 in blowout. Mabrey played just 31 minutes (fewest ever by player with 50-pt game). Received standing ovation when subbed out. Expansion franchise Toronto gets instant history in Year 1.

story_log.title: Timberwolves acquire LaMelo Ball from Hornets in blockbuster trade for Naz Reid and haul of picks, pair Ball with Anthony Edwards
story_log.development: NEW: Charlotte traded LaMelo Ball and Josh Green to Minnesota for Naz Reid, a 2033 unprotected first-round pick, three first-round pick swaps (2028, 2029, 2030), and three second-round picks (2029, 2032, 2033) per Shams. Reunites No. 1 and No. 3 picks from 2020 draft (Ant and Melo). Hornets didn't shop Ball but listened to offers, received multiple rich packages. Timberwolves enter luxury tax for third straight year. Ball averaged 25.3 PPG, 7.8 APG, 5.2 RPG last season. Immediate fit questions: both score-first guards, defense concerns, losing Reid's stretch-5 shooting. Charlotte fills frontcourt need with Reid (17.2 PPG, 6.9 RPG as Sixth Man of Year). Coby White re-signed 3yr/$74M same day to become Charlotte's starting PG.

story_log.title: Rays lose no-hitter with two outs in ninth inning after Craig Kimbrel allows home run to Royals
story_log.development: NEW: Tampa Bay pitchers Casey Legumina and Ian Seymour held Kansas City hitless through 8.1 innings. Craig Kimbrel entered for ninth, allowed home run with two outs to break up no-no. Rays still won 13-2. Would have been first combined no-hitter in Rays history. Kimbrel's blown save two outs from history. TalkinBaseball and CBS Sports covered heartbreak.

story_log.title: Bryce Harper flashes championship ring at Nationals fans who chirped him all week, says 'it's weird coming from a fanbase I sweated for'
story_log.development: NEW: Harper hit go-ahead homer in ninth inning vs Washington, then flashed ring finger at Nationals fans who had been chirping him all series. Postgame: 'It's weird coming from a fanbase that I sweated for for seven years.' Phillies beat Nats 10-5 after trailing 5-0. Harper's signature Philly moment. Jomboy breakdown confirms ring gesture. Harper now has ring, Nats have rebuild.

story_log.title: MLB proposes salary cap, max contract limits (5yr/$202M for FAs), and prop-bet ban in CBA negotiations as MLBPA calls it 'litany of restrictions'
story_log.development: NEW: League proposed salary cap/floor system with strict contract limits: free agents switching teams max 5yr/$202M (15% of cap number), retaining own players max 6yr. No deferred contracts. Qualifying offer eliminated. Players 30+ eligible for free agency after 5 years service. Also proposed ban on all MLB-related prop bets (MLBPA wants this to combat gambler harassment per Passan). Union accused league of 'litany of additional restrictions on player rights.' Passan: parties speaking different languages. Juan Soto's Mets deal (15yr/$765M) was 3x years and 3.8x dollars of proposed max. Major standoff brewing, potential work stoppage looming.

story_log.title: Lions CB Terrion Arnold held without bail after Thursday hearing, faces kidnapping and armed robbery charges with potential life sentence
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Arnold appeared at hearing Thursday in Tampa, ordered held without bail until pre-trial detention hearing scheduled for Monday morning per Schefter/ESPN. Faces four counts kidnapping, four counts armed robbery (eight felonies total) in connection with February incident. Arnold 'categorically denies involvement' per statement. Prosecutors argued he should remain jailed until trial. Lions cornerback's legal situation worsening.

story_log.title: Rays' Junior Caminero hits three home runs vs Royals, drives in six runs in 13-2 blowout
story_log.development: NEW: Caminero went deep three times (6 RBI total) in Tampa's 13-2 rout of Kansas City. First 3-HR game by a Ray since Isaac Paredes in 2022 per StatMuse. Caminero (22) now has 71 career homers, most by a Ray before turning 23. Breakout night for young slugger same game Rays lost no-hitter in ninth.

story_log.title: Cubs sweep Mets in New York, move into second place in NL Central as Mets fall to 34-47
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago swept doubleheader Wednesday (10-3, 10-5 per story history), then won finale 4-3 Thursday to complete sweep at Citi Field. Third mop of season for Cubs (no other team has more than one per StatMuse). Mets now L6, 34-47 (13 games under .500), 9.5 GB of wild card. Just traded David Peterson to Cubs. New York in freefall.

story_log.title: Red Sox beat Yankees 6-3 behind Caleb Durbin homer, move closer in AL East race
story_log.development: NEW: Durbin hit go-ahead homer off Cam Schlittler as Boston beat New York 6-3. Michael Kay (Yankees announcer) told Red Sox fans chanting 'Yankees suck' that 'I guess the standings on the left field board, they can't see those' per Jomboy. First base ump also ejected Red Sox pitching coach Andrew Bailey after check-swing argument. Boston wins series in Bronx.

story_log.title: Pirates cruise past Mariners 5-1 behind Tatsuya Imai's 10-strikeout gem
story_log.development: NEW: Imai struck out 10 and shut down Seattle as Pittsburgh won 5-1. Imai now has back-to-back starts with 10+ Ks (11 vs Guardians in last outing). TalkinBaseball highlighted dominant performance. Pirates pitching rolling.

story_log.title: Athletics score twice with two outs in ninth to stun Giants 9-6 after trailing 6-4
story_log.development: NEW: A's trailed 6-4 entering ninth, scored back-to-back hits with two outs to take lead and beat Giants 9-6. TalkinBaseball: 'A'S DO IT AGAIN' (second late comeback in recent days). Oakland's late-inning magic continues.

story_log.title: Phillies rally from 5-0 deficit to beat Nationals 10-5 behind Bryce Harper's go-ahead homer in ninth
story_log.development: NEW: Philadelphia trailed Washington 5-0, then scored seven unanswered. Harper hit go-ahead homer in ninth, flashed ring finger at Nationals fans postgame. Philly wins 10-5. (See supporting story above for Harper details.)

story_log.title: Astros edge Tigers 2-1 in pitcher's duel
story_log.development: NEW: Houston beat Detroit 2-1 in low-scoring game. No viral moments, just a tight game Astros won.

story_log.title: Rangers edge Blue Jays 6-5 behind Wyatt Langford's three-run blast off Kevin Gausman
story_log.development: NEW: Langford hit three-run homer off Gausman (struggling this month: 0-3, 7.62 ERA in June) to give Texas lead. Rangers won 6-5. Kazuma Okamoto hit two-run pinch-hit homer in ninth to bring Jays within one but they fell short. Blue Jays fan gave Rangers HR ball to little kid Rangers fan per Jomboy (wholesome moment). Texas wins tight game.

story_log.title: Blue Jays' Ernie Clement will start at 2B for American League in All-Star Game after leading AL in votes
story_log.development: NEW: Clement led AL in All-Star voting, will be starting second baseman per TalkinBaseball and MLB announcement. Shohei Ohtani will start at DH for NL after leading NL in votes. All-Star finalists announced. Voting continues for final spots.

story_log.title: Suns sign restricted FA center Mark Williams to 3yr/$38M deal, locking up starting big man
story_log.development: NEW: Williams (restricted FA) intends to sign 3yr/$38M fully guaranteed to return to Phoenix per Shams. Averaged 11 PPG, 8 RPG, 1 BLK in 23.6 MPG as Suns starting center. Suns finished re-signing own priority free agents (Gillespie, Goodwin, now Williams) after weekend deals.

story_log.title: Hornets re-sign Coby White to 3yr/$74M deal hours after trading LaMelo Ball, White becomes new starting PG
story_log.development: NEW: White (free agent) intends to sign 3yr/$74M to return to Charlotte per Shams. Major priority for Hornets, steps into new starting role in backcourt after Ball trade. White averaged 18.9 PPG, 5.1 APG, 4.8 RPG last season. Locked up same day as Ball trade, gives Charlotte offensive continuity.

story_log.title: Warriors' Al Horford declines player option, re-signs on 2yr/$14M deal to reach 20th NBA season at age 40
story_log.development: NEW: Horford declined player option, intends to sign new 2yr/$14M to stay with Golden State per Shams. Becomes only 13th player in NBA history to reach 20 seasons. 40-year-old veteran choosing security over testing market. Warriors retain big-man depth.

story_log.title: Lions CB Terrion Arnold arrested on kidnapping and armed robbery charges, faces life in prison
story_log.development: NEW: Arnold was arrested Wednesday in Tampa and faces four counts of kidnapping and four counts of armed robbery (eight felony counts total) in connection with a February robbery/kidnapping. Charges carry potential life sentence. Arnold voluntarily surrendered at Orient Road Jail. Statement from his camp: 'categorically denies involvement.' Massive story for Detroit, second-year cornerback selected 24th overall in 2025 draft.

story_log.title: 2026 NBA Draft Round 2: Isaiah Stewart traded to Grizzlies, Braden Smith swapped to Pacers, LaMelo Ball trade rumors dominate Day 2
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Round 2 Wednesday night. Pistons traded Isaiah Stewart to Grizzlies for three future second-rounders (salary dump). Bulls drafted Braden Smith at 15 then immediately traded him to Pacers for Kam Jones + cash. Hornets engaged in serious trade talks for LaMelo Ball per Shams—multiple teams 'aggressively pursuing' him, could move quickly. Timberwolves and Raptors named as suitors. Austin Reaves re-signed with Lakers (4 years, $185M max). Round 2 trades and drama continued.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark exits Fever loss with back injury after Alyssa Thomas appeared to punch her throat, Stephanie White blasts refs for 'cheap shots'
story_log.development: NEW: Clark exited Mercury game with back issue and did not return. Fever coach Stephanie White went off on officials postgame for not calling what she deemed two 'cheap shots' against Clark, including play where Alyssa Thomas appeared to push her fist into Clark's neck during scramble for loose ball. Video shows Thomas's fist into Clark's throat, no call. Mercury won 111-109. HaterReport, NBAMemes, ClutchPoints all highlighted punch video. White: 'utterly disrespectful.'

story_log.title: World Cup Group Stage final matchday: Mexico sweeps group with 3-0 win, South Africa advances to knockouts for first time in history, Brazil cruises
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 11]: Final group-stage games Wednesday. Mexico beat Czechia 3-0 in Mexico City (Mateo Chavez, Julián Quiñones, Alvaro Fidalgo), swept Group A for first time since 2002. Crowd electric, Memo Ochoa subbed on to huge ovation. South Africa beat South Korea 1-0 (Thapelo Maseko 63'), first time Bafana Bafana advance to knockouts in WC history. Morocco beat Haiti 4-2 in wild first half. Brazil beat Scotland 3-0 (Vini Jr. scored, broke Brazilian group-stage scoring record per ESPN—first to score in all three matches since Ronaldo/Rivaldo 2002). Switzerland beat Canada 2-1. Group stage complete, knockout round set.

story_log.title: Cubs acquire David Peterson from Mets, first piece of New York sell-off as trade deadline looms
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago acquired LHP David Peterson from Mets per Passan. Peterson lost rotation spot in NY, has 6.09 ERA but 3.85 FIP and 51.1% groundball rate—moving from Mets' worst-in-MLB infield defense to Cubs' best-in-MLB infield could be huge. Will be free agent after season. Passan: first piece, rival executives expect plenty more from Mets before Aug. 3 deadline. Cubs desperately need starting pitching (Javier Assad only reliable arm per BarstoolBigCat).

story_log.title: Dansby Swanson drives in 15 runs across Cubs-Mets doubleheader, breaks Ron Santo's franchise record
story_log.development: NEW: Swanson had 11 RBI in Wednesday's doubleheader vs Mets (2 HR, 7 RBI in Game 2 alone), breaking Cubs' single-doubleheader RBI record of 10 set by Ron Santo in 1970. Over last two days vs NYM: 15 RBI total. StatMuse: 'Drove in more runs than the Mets' across the series. Mets committed six errors in Game 2, fans chanted 'Pete Alonso' as team fell to fifth straight loss. Cubs swept doubleheader 10-3, 10-5.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani and catcher Dalton Rushing 'out of sync' after crossed-up pitch, Ohtani rebounds for win but Rushing visibly upset
story_log.development: NEW: Ohtani and Rushing got crossed up on pitch in second inning (ball got past Rushing's glove, run scored). Ohtani said postgame he was 'out of sync' with catcher. Rushing had extended talks in dugout with Freeman, Roberts, mental skills coach. Jomboy breakdown shows Rushing disagreed with Ohtani's decision to challenge a pitch earlier, Shohei was right. Rushing visibly not pleased with himself. Ohtani still got win as Dodgers beat Twins 4-3. Mookie Betts hit 300th career HR same game.

story_log.title: Pirates demolish Mariners 11-1 behind offensive explosion, Ryan O'Hearn hits three doubles
story_log.development: NEW: Pittsburgh crushed Seattle 11-1. Ryan O'Hearn went 4-4 with 3 doubles, 3 RBI—first player with 3 2B and 3 RBI in a game this season per StatMuse. Paul Goldschmidt hit two homers off Tarik Skubal (first player with multi-HR game vs Skubal since Goldschmidt himself in 2021). Skubal received lengthy trainer visit mid-game but stayed in—TalkinBaseball later reported injury scare was actually self-inflicted nut shot during delivery. Pirates offense erupts.

story_log.title: Phillies take lead down to last strike on Nick Castellanos single, beat Nationals 5-4
story_log.development: NEW: Philadelphia trailed Nationals entering 9th, scored in bottom of 9th with two outs to take lead and win 5-4. TalkinBaseball: 'Phillies take the lead down to their last strike!' Castellanos delivered clutch hit. Philly walks it off.

story_log.title: Padres sweep Braves behind strong pitching, Matt Olson finds entire family of Waldos in stands
story_log.development: NEW: San Diego beat Atlanta 5-2 to complete sweep. Matt Olson spotted entire family of Waldos in crowd (TalkinBaseball video). Padres pitching dominant all series. Braves swept at home.

story_log.title: Rafael Devers ties game with homer in ninth, Rockies walk off Red Sox in extras after Aroldis Chapman meltdown
story_log.development: NEW: Devers hit 9th-inning homer to tie game 6-6. Then Rockies walked off Boston 8-6 in extras. Chapman allowed four straight baserunners in meltdown (1B, 1B, 1B, 1B, 3B) per StatMuse. Second blown save for Chapman in last week. Colorado completes comeback.

story_log.title: Brewers sweep Reds to reach 20 games over .500, Abner Uribe serves one-game suspension nearly a month late
story_log.development: NEW: Milwaukee beat Cincinnati 6-5 to complete sweep, now 20 games over .500. Reliever Abner Uribe served his one-game suspension Wednesday night—nearly a month after MLB handed down penalty per ESPN. Brewers rolling, Reds swept.

story_log.title: Angels walk off Orioles on check-swing single after Baltimore blew 6-1 lead
story_log.development: NEW: Los Angeles trailed 6-1, rallied to tie, then walked off Baltimore 7-6 on check-swing hit. TalkinBaseball: 'CHECK SWING WALK-OFF' with video. Orioles bullpen collapses, Angels complete comeback at home.

story_log.title: White Sox tie game on back-to-back homers with two outs in ninth, Guardians walk off in extras
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago hit back-to-back homers down to final out in 9th to tie Cleveland 3-3. Then Guardians walked off 4-3 in extras. TalkinBaseball: 'White Sox tie it down to their final out with back-to-back homers!' Wild finish.

story_log.title: Víctor Bericoto walks off Athletics in 10th as Giants edge Oakland 2-1
story_log.development: NEW: Bericoto delivered walk-off hit in 10th inning to give San Francisco 2-1 win over A's. TalkinBaseball highlighted. Tight pitcher's duel, Giants win in extras.

story_log.title: Tarik Skubal receives lengthy trainer visit after accidentally hitting himself during delivery, stays in game and gives up two homers
story_log.development: NEW: Skubal received extended trainer visit mid-game vs Pirates but stayed in. TalkinBaseball later reported (via Cody Stavenhagen): injury scare was accidental nut shot during delivery. Jomboy: 'Tarik Skubal's injury scare was actually a self-inflicted nut shot.' Skubal then gave up two homers to Paul Goldschmidt (first multi-HR game vs Skubal since Goldschmidt 2021). Tigers lost 11-1 to Pirates, Skubal's tough night.

story_log.title: Mets commit six errors in 10-5 loss to Cubs, fans chant 'Pete Alonso' as team spirals to fifth straight loss
story_log.development: NEW: New York committed six errors in Game 2 of doubleheader vs Cubs, lost 10-5. TalkinBaseball posted video of all six errors. Jomboy: 'Mets fans are chanting Pete Alonso at Citi Field as the team is about to suffer its fifth loss in a row in a game where they committed six errors.' Alonso was traded away earlier this season, fans miss him. Mets in freefall, just traded David Peterson to Cubs.

story_log.title: Red Sox broadcast uses 'Connor Wong is dating a magician' as his fun fact again
story_log.development: NEW: Boston broadcast showed graphic for catcher Connor Wong during Rockies series. Fun fact: 'dating a magician.' TalkinBaseball (via BlakesTakes2): 'Surely there's another fact about Connor Wong to use.' Same graphic used multiple times this season. Wong's relationship status remains broadcast's go-to trivia.

story_log.title: Olivia Miles posts 20-point game, now has seven as a rookie—more than 2nd and 3rd place combined
story_log.development: NEW: Miles recorded another 20-point game vs opponent. StatMuse: '20-point games by a rookie: 7 — Olivia Miles, 6 — 2nd and 3rd place combined.' Lynx rookie continues dominant season. Minnesota won.

story_log.title: Natasha Howard posts 21-15 vs Mystics, now top three in PTS + REB this season
story_log.development: NEW: Howard vs Washington: 21 PTS, 15 REB, 2 STL. StatMuse: 'Top three in PTS + REB this season.' Valkyries beat Mystics 77-66. Howard's two-way dominance continues.

story_log.title: 2026 NBA Draft: AJ Dybantsa goes No. 1 to Wizards, Michigan's championship trio splits first round, Dusty May drafts his own player
story_log.development: NEW: AJ Dybantsa went No. 1 to Washington as expected. Darryn Peterson went No. 2 to Utah (had only visited Wizards, snubbed Jazz). Cameron Boozer No. 3 to Memphis. Caleb Wilson No. 4 to Chicago (Caleb W. phenomenon continues). Michigan's national champion trio all went lottery: Morez Johnson Jr. No. 9 to Dallas (Dusty May's new team—reunited with his former player), Yaxel Lendeborg No. 11 to Warriors, Aday Mara No. 12 to Thunder. Three lottery picks from one reigning champ is historic (third time since 1985 lottery began). Draft produced immediate storylines: May coaching his own recruit in Dallas, Bulls landing another 'Caleb W.', Peterson's cold shoulder to Utah, and trades throughout first round.

story_log.title: Dusty May officially named Mavericks head coach, promptly drafts his own Michigan player Morez Johnson Jr. at No. 9
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: May was officially introduced as Mavericks head coach Tuesday morning (Schefter confirmed). Hours later at NBA Draft, Dallas selected his former Michigan big man Morez Johnson Jr. at No. 9. May's face on broadcast: beaming smile. First move as NBA coach is drafting his own recruit. BarstoolBigCat: 'Chill out Dusty, you don't have to recruit anymore.' Instant storyline for Dallas.

story_log.title: World Cup Tuesday: Portugal routs Uzbekistan 5-0, Croatia sneaks past Panama 1-0, England-Ghana ends scoreless after Harry Kane miss, Colombia beats Congo DR 1-0
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 10]: Portugal crushed Uzbekistan 5-0 (Ronaldo scored twice, 'I'M BACK! I'M BACK!' celebration went viral—first two WC goals of tournament for him after 1,000 goalless minutes). Croatia beat Panama 1-0. England drew Ghana 0-0 after Harry Kane missed sitter in front of goal (witch doctor curse mentioned by fans). Colombia beat DR Congo 1-0. Group stage rolls on with massive stakes for knockout round.

story_log.title: NFL blocks Brendan Sorsby from 2026 Supplemental Draft, cites gambling integrity concerns and short application timeline
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: NFL declined to hold Supplemental Draft, blocking Sorsby's 2026 path to league. League sent letter to Sorsby (obtained by Schefter, Pelissero, Breer) citing: application filed just 3 business days before June 22 deadline with no supporting docs, Sorsby's sustained NCAA gambling violations (bet on own team/teammates, intermediary accounts), lack of accountability, integrity concerns given NFL's gambling partnerships. Sorsby's attorney Kessler (via Pelissero statement): NFL gave no indication they'd need more than application, declined invitation for more info, sent denial letter to media before Sorsby. Kessler called it 'violation of CBA and the law,' will pursue with NFLPA. Sorsby now stuck out of football for 2026 season, must wait until 2027 NFL Draft. AlbertBreer: league drawing hard line on gambling, has let in players with drugs/grades/NCAA violations before but never this. Breer noted NFL's argument about '3 business days' is confusing since deadline was the actual deadline.

story_log.title: Tuesday's wildest MLB moments: Jazz Chisholm's lollipop celebration, Manny Machado walk-off, PCA called out on walk for leaving the bag
story_log.development: NEW: Yankees beat Tigers 4-3 behind Jazz Chisholm Jr. go-ahead homer (celebrated with lollipops after Aaron Boone banned them on field—TalkinYanks: clubhouse blasted 'Lollipop' by Lil Wayne postgame). Padres' Manny Machado walked off Braves with hit. Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong advanced to second on a walk, came off bag, got tagged out—umps ruled him out (Jomboy: 'call PCA out because he advanced to second on the walk but then came off the bag'). Dodgers' Justin Wrobleski threw 6.0 shutout IP (2.51 ERA in 13 starts, StatMuse). Royals' Jac Caglianone hit two homers vs Rays (4 HR, 6 RBI in last three games). White Sox walked off Guardians 2-1. A's Zack Gelof's 24-game hit streak snapped after being cleated by Matt Chapman and leaving game.

story_log.title: Falcons sign Kyle Pitts to 3-year, $54M extension, making him third-highest-paid tight end in NFL
story_log.development: NEW: Atlanta extended Pitts (3 years, $54M, $36M fully guaranteed) per Schefter. Largest three-year TE contract in NFL history. Pitts now third-highest-paid TE at $18M/year (behind Kittle $19.1M, McBride $19M). After career-best season and All-Pro honors, Pitts lands historic deal. Falcons have now extended Drake London (4 years, $141.05M) and Pitts this offseason. Bijan Robinson up next per Schefter.

story_log.title: Bills great Jim Kelly reveals he recently suffered a stroke but feels 'really good' now
story_log.development: NEW: Kelly told reporters he recently suffered a stroke but now feels 'really good' per Schefter/ESPN. Bills legend and Hall of Fame QB addressing health scare publicly. No timeline given on when stroke occurred. Kelly has battled cancer multiple times in past decade. Buffalo icon providing update on latest health challenge.

story_log.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo traded to Miami Heat in blockbuster, Celtics offered Jaylen Brown + picks, ended 13-month saga
story_log.development: NEW: Bucks traded Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis to Miami for Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis, 3 first-round picks (including No. 13), 1 pick swap, 1 second-rounder. Celtics offered Jaylen Brown + 2 first-rounders, were finalists with Miami. Giannis preferred Miami/Boston/Minnesota. Milwaukee chose Miami's haul over Brown package. Heat land 2x MVP and Finals MVP, pair with Bam Adebayo. 13-month trade saga ends.

story_log.title: Timberwolves trade Julius Randle to Nets in three-team deal, clear salary for Ayo Dosunmu extension
story_log.development: NEW: Minnesota sent Randle and No. 28 pick to Brooklyn, Nets sent Nic Claxton to Bulls, Timberwolves acquired No. 33 pick. Timberwolves clear salary to re-sign Ayo Dosunmu (5 years, $112M). Randle back to NYC after one season in Minnesota (20 PPG, 6.9 RPG, 4.9 APG). Nets acquire three-time All-Star into cap space plus first-rounder.

story_log.title: Ayo Dosunmu signs 5-year, $112M extension with Timberwolves after breakout postseason
story_log.development: NEW: Dosunmu signed 5-year, $112M deal with player option in Year 5 to return to Minnesota. Major priority after tremendous postseason. 14 PPG on 52/41/93% regular season, 16 PPG on 50/43/93% playoffs. Chemistry with Anthony Edwards key. Timberwolves made it happen after Randle trade cleared salary.

story_log.title: Dusty May leaves Michigan for Dallas Mavericks coaching job, 11 weeks after national title
story_log.development: NEW: May finalized deal to coach Mavericks per Shams, leaving Michigan 11 weeks after leading them to national championship. First college coach to take NBA job since John Beilein 2019. Allure of coaching Cooper Flagg helped draw May. Michigan now has 15-day portal window open, roster in limbo. CBS: May never intended to stay long, landscape accelerated decision. Jon Rothstein: Michigan should be grateful they had two years. Axios-shifting move.

story_log.title: Oklahoma wins College World Series, beats UNC 13-2 in Game 3 after improbable postseason run
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 4]: Oklahoma won 13-2 over UNC in winner-take-all Game 3 to claim national championship, first since 1994. Finished 11th in SEC (14-16), trailed Georgia Tech 8-2 on brink of elimination, then won 10 of final 11 including sweeps of Georgia Tech and Kansas. Beat only top-8 seeds in Omaha. Most dominant postseason run in college baseball history. SEC's seventh straight national championship.

story_log.title: Messi breaks World Cup goal record, Mbappé and Haaland score braces on same day as golden boot race heats up
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Messi scored twice vs Austria (5th and 6th goals of tournament), now 17 career WC goals (breaks Klose's record). Mbappé scored twice vs Iraq after two-hour weather delay (also 6 WC goals this tournament). Haaland scored twice vs Senegal (4 career WC goals, most in Norway history). All three scored braces for second straight week. Golden Boot race is Messi 6, Mbappé 6, everyone else chasing. Norway and France both through to knockout stage.

story_log.title: Norway does viral 'Viking Row' celebration after clinching knockout round, France-Iraq delayed two hours by weather
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 9]: Norway beat Senegal 3-2, team and fans did 'Viking Row' celebration at MetLife Stadium after clinching knockout stage (Haaland led it). France beat Iraq 3-0 after historic two-hour weather delay (lightning, heavy rain in Philadelphia). First WC game ever delayed by weather. Algeria beat Jordan 2-1. Group stage rolling.

story_log.title: Titans sign DT Jeffery Simmons to 3-year, $105.8M extension
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Tennessee extended Simmons 3 years, $105.8M per Schefter/Rapoport. Massive deal for Titans defensive anchor. AlbertBreer: Simmons broke ground for younger defensive tackles getting paid.

story_log.title: Trae Young signs 4-year, $212M extension with Wizards after declining player option
story_log.development: NEW: Young signed 4-year, $212M deal (player option Year 4) to stay in Washington after declining $49M option. Stamps desire to be in D.C. and elevate young core. CBS: huge overpay for offensively inclined, defensively deficient All-Star. Max he could have signed elsewhere. Wizards committed.

story_log.title: Brittney Griner becomes WNBA's all-time blocks leader with 878 and counting
story_log.development: NEW: Griner vs Sky: 4 BLK (!!), 14 PTS (22 MIN), 8 REB. Now leads WNBA all-time with 878 blocks. Second all-time in 3-block games. ESPN and StatMuse highlighted milestone.

story_log.title: Top draft picks Paige Bueckers and Azzi Fudd both deliver: Bueckers 37 pts, Fudd 26 pts on efficient shooting
story_log.development: NEW: Bueckers (No. 2 pick) posted 37 PTS, 12 REB, 2 BLK. Fudd (No. 3 pick) had 26 PTS, 3 STL on 11-17 FG. Top two picks from 2025 draft showed out same night. StatMuse highlighted.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark drops 24 pts, 9 ast vs Phoenix, averaging 26/9 over last six games
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Clark vs PHX: 24 PTS, 9 AST. Averaging 26 PPG and 9 APG over last six games per StatMuse. Fever beat Mercury 86-77. Clark's hot stretch continues.

story_log.title: Dodgers become first team to 50 wins this season after sweeping Twins
story_log.development: NEW: LA beat Twins 2-1 to reach 50 wins, first team to milestone. StatMuse: Only one AL team has more than 43 wins (Orioles). Dodgers and Braves (48) dominating NL, Brewers (47) close behind. Kyle Tucker exited with back spasms (day-to-day).

story_log.title: Aroldis Chapman blows save after allowing four straight baserunners, Rockies walk off Red Sox
story_log.development: NEW: Chapman in 9th: 1B, 1B, 1B, 1B, 3B. Allowed four straight baserunners, Rockies walked off Boston. Chapman's second blown save in last week. StatMuse and TalkinBaseball highlighted meltdown.

story_log.title: White Sox walk off Guardians with two outs in ninth after Sam Antonacci single
story_log.development: NEW: Antonacci walked it off with Sox down to last out, Chicago beat Cleveland 6-5. TalkinBaseball highlighted. Tigers won 5-3 over Yankees. AL Central chaos.

story_log.title: Manny Machado's 14th homer puts Padres in front vs Braves
story_log.development: NEW: Machado hit solo shot (14th HR of year) to give Padres lead over Atlanta. TalkinBaseball and ESPN highlighted. Braves-Padres on ESPN.

story_log.title: Framber Valdez posts 2.45 ERA this month, Tigers go 2-2 in his four starts
story_log.development: NEW: Valdez this month: 22.0 IP, 21 SO, 2.45 ERA, 1.36 WHIP. Detroit 2-2 in his starts. StatMuse highlighted. Tigers beat Yankees 5-3 on Monday.

story_log.title: Brandon Woodruff strikes out 10 in first start since April 30, allows just one baserunner
story_log.development: NEW: Woodruff: 10 SO, 1 H allowed, perfect game into 6th inning in first start since April 30. TalkinBaseball and StatMuse highlighted dominant return. Brewers beat Reds 2-1.

story_log.title: White Sox activate Kyle Teel from 60-day IL, catcher makes season debut
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago activated Teel (24-year-old catcher) from 60-day IL Monday, made season debut. Went 0-4 in team's 6-5 win over Guardians. ESPN and StatMuse reported.

story_log.title: Taylor Ward homers in first game visiting Anaheim after trade, leadoff blast for Orioles
story_log.development: NEW: Ward (traded from Angels) hit leadoff homer in first game back at Angel Stadium. Baltimore beat LA 6-1 behind Kyle Bradish's 8.0 shutout IP. TalkinBaseball highlighted.

story_log.title: Wyndham Clark wins second U.S. Open in wire-to-wire victory, survives antagonistic crowd and late push from Sam Burns
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Clark won U.S. Open by one stroke at Shinnecock Hills, leading wire-to-wire (first since 2014). Survived 6-shot lead nearly evaporating, crowd rooting against him all Sunday. Sam Burns charged to second place, Scheffler faded. Clark's father flew red-eye on Father's Day to surprise him on 18th green. Clark becomes fifth player to lead by multiple shots after all four rounds in U.S. Open history.

story_log.title: Brady Tkachuk traded to Panthers, reunites with brother Matthew after Ottawa sends captain south
story_log.development: Florida acquired Brady Tkachuk from Ottawa for two 2026 first-round picks, a future first, and a future second. Brothers reunited on Panthers roster after Brady orchestrated trade destination. Two-time Cup champion Panthers missed playoffs last season, adding rugged captain to retool.

story_log.title: Thunder trade Aaron Wiggins to Hawks for second-round picks, trim massive luxury tax penalty
story_log.development: Oklahoma City sent Wiggins (No. 55 pick 2021, developed into championship role player) to Atlanta for two second-round picks (Atlanta's 2030, least favorable of Hawks/Lakers 2032). Trade cuts Thunder's projected tax penalty from $213M to $152M. OKC now has two picks in top 17 of Tuesday's draft (Nos. 12 and 17).

story_log.title: Egypt earns first-ever World Cup win behind Mo Salah goal, beats New Zealand 3-1 after eight failed attempts
story_log.development: Egypt secured first World Cup win in history (0-8 all-time entering match) with 3-1 victory over New Zealand. Salah scored go-ahead goal, Trezeguet and Mostafa Ziko added insurance. Egypt trailed 1-0 early before storming back. Salah celebrated dancing in Vancouver streets surrounded by fans. Historic moment for Egyptian football after 52 years of futility.

story_log.title: Cape Verde earns second World Cup point with chaotic 2-2 draw vs Uruguay, scores first-ever goal on stunning free kick
story_log.development: Cape Verde (pop. 600K) scored first-ever World Cup goal (Kevin Pina free kick) and rallied twice to draw Uruguay 2-2. Hélio Varela equalized in 61st after Uruguay went up 2-1, then referee blew whistle during Cape Verde free kick in stoppage time, robbing them of potential winner. Tiny island nation now has 2 points from 2 games (drew Spain 0-0 in opener) and positioning for knockout round. Varela celebrated goal with basketball hesi tween move.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber leads MLB with 29 homers after three-homer night, Bryce Harper completes cycle in Phillies rout
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Schwarber hit three homers Sunday (29 on season, MLB lead) in 15-3 rout of Mets. Harper became 11th Phillies player to hit for cycle Saturday (9th in franchise history, first since 2024). Phillies scoring at will this weekend against New York.

story_log.title: Nneka Ogwumike hits game-winner at buzzer as Sparks complete 17-point comeback to beat Liberty in WNBA 30th anniversary game
story_log.development: Ogwumike's buzzer-beating three-pointer capped Sparks' 17-point comeback to beat Liberty 98-97 in rematch of WNBA's inaugural game from 1997. Ogwumike finished with 24 PTS, 6 REB, 3 STL on 11-18 FG. Liberty led most of the way before LA stormed back. Emotional night celebrating 30 years of WNBA.

story_log.title: Spain routs Saudi Arabia 4-0 as 17-year-old Lamine Yamal scores first World Cup goal, Japan demolishes Tunisia 4-0
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 8]: Spain crushed Saudi Arabia 4-0 with Yamal (17) scoring first WC goal. Japan beat Tunisia 4-0. Iran and Belgium drew 0-0 after Iran left handwritten 'peace' note in SoFi Stadium dressing room. Group stage rolling.

story_log.title: CJ McCollum signs one-year, $21M extension to stay with Hawks through 2027
story_log.development: McCollum extended one year, $21M (plus trade kicker) with Atlanta per Shams. Hawks went 19-4 with him as starter from Feb. 22 through end of season. Closed 11th straight year with 150+ threes (tied 4th-most such campaigns in NBA history). Signed through next season, avoiding free agency.

story_log.title: Jordan Goodwin returns to Suns on 3-year, $19M deal after culture-fit breakout season
story_log.development: Goodwin (made roster on non-guaranteed deal) signed 3-year, $19M with player option in Year 3 to return to Phoenix per Shams. Averaged 8.7 PPG, 4.9 RPG, 2.2 APG, team-high 106 steals. Suns locking up young guards (Goodwin and Collin Gillespie) after developmental success.

story_log.title: Colby Thomas robs homer with catch-of-the-year candidate, A's beat Angels
story_log.development: Thomas made ridiculous leaping catch at wall to rob homer vs Angels. SportsCenter, Jomboy, SleeperHQ all called it catch-of-the-year candidate. A's beat Angels 9-7 after trailing 4-0 early. Zach Neto delivered go-ahead hit for LA in 9th but Oakland rallied.

story_log.title: Rafael Devers tries to reject pinch-runner in ninth inning as tying run, Giants manager says 'you know how competitive he is'
story_log.development: Devers didn't want to be pulled for pinch-runner as tying run in ninth inning vs Marlins. Jomboy breakdown captured exchange. Giants manager Tony Vitello: 'You know how competitive he is.' Marlins won 2-1.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani announces birth of second child, homers in loss to Orioles after returning from paternity leave
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Ohtani announced second child born on social media, returned from paternity list and homered same day. Dodgers lost to Orioles 12-1 (Baltimore crushed LA). Ohtani back, but Dodgers blown out.

story_log.title: North Carolina forces Game 3 in College World Series Finals with 6-2 win over Oklahoma, winner-take-all Monday
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: UNC beat Oklahoma 6-2 in Game 2 to force winner-take-all Game 3 Monday. Caden Glauber (18) threw masterclass: 5 IP, 1 H, 8 K. Tar Heels even series 1-1. National championship on the line Monday in Omaha.

story_log.title: Serena Williams granted wild card to play singles at Wimbledon, also teaming with Venus in doubles
story_log.development: Serena received wild card to play singles at Wimbledon per ESPN, also returning to play doubles with Venus. Comeback extends to second Grand Slam. Major story for tennis as Williams returns to grass courts.

story_log.title: Royals' Jac Caglianone hits two homers vs Cardinals, first Royal with 2 HR/3 RBI/2 BB game since 2019
story_log.development: Caglianone went 2-3 with 2 HR, 3 RBI, 2 BB vs Cardinals. First Royals player with that line in a game since 2019 per StatMuse. Kansas City lost 12-10 but Caglianone continuing to Figure It Out per CespedesBBQ. Royals and Cardinals honored Negro Leagues with special hats.

story_log.title: Orioles demolish Dodgers 12-1 behind Pete Alonso homer, Baltimore clobbers LA
story_log.development: Baltimore crushed Dodgers 12-1. Alonso went oppo for homer. TalkinBaseball: 'Orioles are clobbering the Dodgers 10-1.' O's dominated from start to finish. LA blown out at home.

story_log.title: Justin Verlander likely out 'weeks' with hamstring strain, hints at retirement: 'maybe the wheels are falling off'
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Verlander has left hamstring strain, likely out 'weeks' per Tigers manager A.J. Hinch. Verlander conceded 'maybe the wheels are falling off' after latest injury. Retirement speculation intensifying for 43-year-old future Hall of Famer.

story_log.title: AL home run leader Yordan Alvarez declines Home Run Derby invitation
story_log.development: Alvarez (25 HR, second in MLB) will not participate in Home Run Derby per Chandler Rome. TalkinBaseball reported decline. Derby field shrinking as sluggers pass.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber hits three homers, Bryce Harper completes first career cycle in same game as Phillies demolish Mets 15-3
story_log.development: Schwarber hit three home runs (5th career 3-HR game, most in Phillies history with 4), Harper completed first career cycle (9th in Phillies history, first since 2024), Phillies beat Mets 15-3. Harper's cycle came in first five innings, fastest since Adrian Beltre 2015.

story_log.title: Wyndham Clark takes 6-shot lead into final round of U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills, Scottie Scheffler lurking
story_log.development: Round 3: Clark shot even-par 70 to extend lead to 6 shots heading into Sunday. Scheffler six back in final pairing, has chance at career grand slam. Clark's 6-shot lead is third-largest after 54 holes in U.S. Open history (behind Rory 2011, Tiger 2000).

story_log.title: Netherlands demolish Sweden 5-1 to break World Cup record, Curaçao goalkeeper Eloy Room ties Tim Howard save record in historic draw
story_log.development: Netherlands beat Sweden 5-1, broke tournament record per ESPN. Curaçao goalkeeper Eloy Room made 15 saves (tied Tim Howard's WC record) to earn 0-0 draw vs Ecuador, first-ever World Cup point for island nation (pop. 600K). Germany beat Ivory Coast 2-1 after Deniz Undav scored twice as super sub.

story_log.title: Byron Buxton grand slam keys Twins' 10-run fifth inning, Minnesota crushes Diamondbacks 16-8
story_log.development: Buxton hit grand slam in 10-run fifth inning as Twins beat Diamondbacks 16-8. Minnesota led 16-0 before fifth inning ended. Freddy Peralta allowed career-high 10 ER for Brewers (2.2 IP).

story_log.title: Travis Bazzana goes 4-4 with two homers, surpasses Brice Turang for highest wRC+ among all MLB second basemen
story_log.development: Bazzana (No. 1 pick) went 4-4 with 2 HR vs opponent, wRC+ now 136 (tops among all 2B min. 150 PA, passing Turang). Guardians won 8-1 over Astros.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani returns from paternity leave, homers in Dodgers' 2-3 loss to Orioles after announcing second child
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Ohtani announced second child born Saturday, returned from paternity list and immediately homered in 3-2 loss to Baltimore. Dodgers lose close game.

story_log.title: Reds demolish Yankees 10-2 behind offensive explosion
story_log.development: Cincinnati crushed Yankees 10-2. New York's offense went silent after recent hot stretch.

story_log.title: Pirates tie game in ninth only to have umpires convene and rule baserunner interference, ending game
story_log.development: Pittsburgh tied game until umps got together and ruled baserunner interference, which ended game. Jomboy breakdown shows runner hit fielder's glove. Pirates have lost seven straight with Skenes starting.

story_log.title: Kelsey Mitchell ankle breaker sends opponent to floor, Fever beat Dream
story_log.development: Mitchell hit defender with ankle breaker and drained three vs Dream. Indiana beat Atlanta. ESPN and HaterReport highlighted crossover.

story_log.title: Wings explode for 36 fourth-quarter points to rally from 15 down and stun Sky 93-92
story_log.development: Dallas scored season-high 36 points in fourth quarter to rally from 15-point deficit and beat Chicago 93-92. Wings caught fire late.

story_log.title: Angel Reese becomes fastest player in WNBA history to reach 1,000 career rebounds
story_log.development: Reese reached 1,000 rebounds faster than any player in WNBA history. Dream lost to Fever 96-113. ESPN highlighted milestone.

story_log.title: Oklahoma one win from national championship after blowout Game 1 win over North Carolina
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Oklahoma beat UNC in Game 1 of CWS Finals. Deiten Lachance hit two homers. Sooners one win from title. Game 2 Sunday.

story_log.title: Titans sign DT Jeffery Simmons to $105M+ extension
story_log.development: Tennessee extended Simmons 3 years, $105.8M per Schefter and Rapoport. Massive deal for Titans defensive anchor.

story_log.title: Collin Gillespie returns to Suns on 4-year, $48M deal after breakout campaign
story_log.development: Gillespie (undrafted 2022, three straight two-way deals) signing 4-year, $48M to return to Phoenix per Shams. Set Suns franchise record with 232 threes last season, averaged 12.7 PPG.

story_log.title: USMNT wins Group D for first time since 2010, advances to knockout stage after 2-0 shutout of Australia
story_log.development: Game 2: USA beat Australia 2-0 in Seattle (Balogun forced own goal, Freeman header after VAR review). First shutout since September. First time winning group stage since 2010. Paraguay's 1-0 win over Turkey gave USA first place in Group D. Advance to Round of 32.

story_log.title: Titans DT Jeffery Simmons becomes highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history with $100M guaranteed extension
story_log.development: Tennessee extended Simmons 3 years, $35.3M per year, $100M guaranteed. First DT ever with $100M guaranteed. Highest-paid DT in NFL history, surpassing Chris Jones ($31.75M/yr).

story_log.title: Dodgers walk off Orioles after catcher's throw gets away in 9th inning
story_log.development: LA scored three runs in 9th to walk off Baltimore 6-5. Winning run scored when throw to plate got away. Dodgers rally from behind to beat O's.

story_log.title: Athletics rally from 11-4 deficit to walk off Angels 12-11, Nick Kurtz draws walk-off walk
story_log.development: A's trailed 11-4, rallied to tie it. Jonah Heim hit 2-run homer with Oakland down to final out. Nick Kurtz drew walk-off walk in extras. Oakland's improbable comeback win in Vegas.

story_log.title: Marina Mabrey ties WNBA record with 9 threes, drops career-high 37 points in Tempo comeback win over Sun
story_log.development: Mabrey posted 37 PTS (career-high), 9-12 3PT (ties WNBA single-game record), 21 points in fourth quarter alone. Toronto Tempo beat Connecticut 101-97 after trailing late.

story_log.title: Yankees' Cam Schlittler strikes out 13 in dominant start, continues breakout rookie season
story_log.development: Schlittler: career-high 13 SO vs Cincinnati. Now 8-3 with 1.71 ERA, lowest in AL this season. Yankees phenom rolling.

story_log.title: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong hits homer in third straight game, posts historic 18-game run
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 4]: PCA homered vs Blue Jays, third straight game with HR. Over last 18 games: 34 H, 5 2B, 2 3B, 9 HR, 6 SB — no player in MLB modern era has ever posted those numbers in any 18-game span.

story_log.title: Paraguay beats Turkey 1-0 playing entire second half with 10 men, Turkey eliminated from World Cup
story_log.development: Paraguay scored in first 64 seconds, then Miguel Almirón got red card for covering mouth while talking to Turkish player (first enforcement of Prestianni Rule). Paraguay held on with 10 men entire second half to win 1-0. Turkey dominated possession but lost, eliminated from World Cup.

story_log.title: Brazil beats Haiti 3-0 as Matheus Cunha scores brace, Raphinha exits with injury
story_log.development: Cunha scored twice, Vini Jr added goal as Brazil cruised 3-0 over Haiti. Raphinha left match with non-contact injury, clouds Brazil's WC outlook. Endrick nearly scored first WC goal but was ruled offside.

story_log.title: Tigers ace Justin Verlander hints at retirement after latest injury: 'Maybe the wheels are falling off'
story_log.development: Verlander said after latest injury 'It's a different conversation now' and conceded 'maybe the wheels are falling off.' Has wanted to play until wheels fall off. Retirement speculation growing.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani placed on paternity list, out of Dodgers lineup as baby arrives
story_log.development: Ohtani placed on paternity leave, expected to return over weekend. Baby Ohtani incoming. First child for Dodgers star.

story_log.title: Zack Gelof hit in head with fastball but stays in game for Athletics
story_log.development: Gelof took fastball directly to head during A's-Angels game, but is okay and stayed in. Scary moment in Vegas.

story_log.title: A's manager Mark Kotsay ejected for arguing balls and strikes, hot mic catches every word
story_log.development: Kotsay tossed for arguing balls/strikes with umpire, hot mic captured entire exchange. Jomboy breakdown.

story_log.title: Tarik Skubal gets in screaming match with White Sox dugout after escaping bases-loaded jam
story_log.development: Skubal struck out side with bases loaded, then got in screaming match with Chicago dugout. Jomboy breakdown captured exchange. Tigers won.

story_log.title: Ranger Suarez no-hit bid broken in 7th inning by Josh Naylor double
story_log.development: Suarez carried no-hitter into 7th vs Guardians before Naylor ripped double in gap to end bid. Phillies still won.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll goes single, double, triple, walk vs Twins — homer shy of cycle
story_log.development: Carroll: 1 1B, 1 2B, 1 3B, 1 BB, 4 RBI vs Minnesota. One homer shy of cycle. Diamondbacks star almost completes rare feat.

story_log.title: Jeremy Pena hits first multi-homer game of season for Astros
story_log.development: Pena went deep twice vs opponent, first multi-HR game of 2026 season. Houston shortstop breaks out.

story_log.title: Padres' Ty France posts second 2-HR, 5-RBI game of season and loses again
story_log.development: France: 2 HR, 5 RBI vs Rangers (tied game with second homer off Jacob deGrom). Padres lost anyway. France and Manny Machado both have 2 HR/5 RBI games this year that ended in losses.

story_log.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope exercises $21.6M player option to stay with Grizzlies
story_log.development: KCP exercised $21.6M player option for 2026-27 season per Shams. Staying in Memphis.

story_log.title: ESPN's Kendrick Perkins becomes Jackson State men's basketball GM while keeping analyst role
story_log.development: Perkins agreed to become Jackson State's men's basketball GM while continuing ESPN role. Latest retired NBA player to take admin position in college hoops (joins John Wall at Howard, Steph at Davidson, Trae at Oklahoma).

story_log.title: Knicks championship parade draws over 2 million fans, delivers chaos and viral moments
story_log.development: Championship parade Thursday drew 2+ million to NYC streets. Tyler Kolek mistaken for fan and detained by NYPD. Fan passed out, woman saved him, he tried to kiss her. Josh Hart's wife stuck her thumb up his butt. Carmelo Anthony: 'I helped build this. A ring would be appreciated.' Wemby heckled. Timothée Chalamet on float. Alicia Keys performed. Parade generated insane viral moments.

story_log.title: Andrew Benintendi pinch-hit grand slam lifts White Sox over Yankees 5-1, first 4-run loss of season for NY
story_log.development: White Sox beat Yankees 5-1. Benintendi crushed pinch-hit grand slam to break open game. First time all season Yankees lost by 4+ runs. Jazz Chisholm Jr. left game after fouling ball off manhood. Chicago rolling, Yankees shocked.

story_log.title: Mexico tops Group A for first time since 2002 after Luis Romo goal sinks South Korea 1-0
story_log.development: Mexico beat South Korea 1-0 in Guadalajara. Luis Romo scored lone goal. SK goalkeeper blunder led to goal, internet roasted keeper. Mexico finishes first in Group A for first time since 2002. Huge result for El Tri at home.

story_log.title: Canada demolishes Qatar 6-0, Jonathan David hat trick sparks Golden Boot race
story_log.development: Canada destroyed Qatar 6-0. Jonathan David scored hat trick. Nathan Saliba scored sensational free kick minutes after coming on for injured Ismaël Koné, threw up No. 8 and jersey for brother. Brawl nearly broke out after Koné's broken leg. Canada cruises, Qatar humiliated.

story_log.title: Angel Reese picks up first regular-season win vs Caitlin Clark behind 21-11 performance
story_log.development: Reese posted 21 PTS, 11 REB, 8-14 FG as Dream beat Fever 108-101 on road. Clark had 26 PTS, 7 AST, 8-17 FG. Reese mocked Clark for foul baiting during game. First time Reese has beaten Clark in regular season since rookie year.

story_log.title: Mike Trout to injured list with hamstring strain, could miss All-Star Game in Philadelphia
story_log.development: Angels placed Trout on 10-day IL with right hamstring strain. Having resurgent season at 34, All-Star level production. May miss All-Star Game in Philly. Latest injury setback for Trout.

story_log.title: MLB proposes removing high school players from draft, cutting rounds from 20 to 12
story_log.development: MLB proposed eliminating high school eligibility from draft, making college players eligible after sophomore year, shortening draft from 20 to 12 rounds, cutting bonus pool from $358.7M to $200M. Also proposed international draft. Major CBA proposal from league.

story_log.title: Braves acquire catcher Joey Bart from Pirates
story_log.development: Atlanta acquired Bart from Pittsburgh per TalkinBaseball. Former top prospect joins Braves. Trade made during World Cup day.

story_log.title: Salvador Perez passes George Brett for most home runs at Kauffman Stadium with No. 137
story_log.development: Perez hit 137th career homer at Kauffman Stadium, passing Brett for most all-time at their home ballpark. Royals milestone for franchise icon.

story_log.title: Bobby Witt Jr. exits game after appearing to hurt right leg, pinch-hit for immediately
story_log.development: Witt left game vs Cardinals after appearing to hurt right leg. Initially stayed in but was pinch-hit for in bottom of inning. Royals monitoring superstar.

story_log.title: Juan Soto hits two home runs vs White Sox, Yankees fall 5-1
story_log.development: Soto hit two homers (one way gone, one in 7th) vs Chicago. Yankees lost 5-1 after Benintendi's grand slam. Soto provided offense, wasn't enough.

story_log.title: NHL clears Mike Babcock to coach again, opening path for Oilers to hire him
story_log.development: NHL announced Babcock is clear to coach after investigation into Columbus resignation in Sept 2023. Edmonton can now hire him. League investigation complete.

story_log.title: MLB announces new HR Derby format: 8 participants, 20 swings Round 1, 15 swings final rounds
